item.title: What more could I add? Something is missing.
item.content:encoded: In a draft I'm writing I have two medium and long length test logs that should efficiently tell the story of the SCP's origin. I'm probably going to write a journal for a civilian during the anomaly (it's an event anomaly) but I still feel like I am missing a lot of stuff. I can post the link to the sandbox if anyone wants.
